title: Think SMP Official Modpack
description: This is the official Modpack for the Think SMP! Hope you enjoy!
body:
This is the official High Quality modpack for the ThinkSMP!! Hope you enjoy the SMP! This is meant to be run on higher quality computers and bring the best quality possible with things like better leaves and animations, shader support, performance mods, and 3d skins!  
Add Replay Mod if you want!

Simple Voice Chat will be added as Well!

Don't forget to join the discord: https://discord.gg/xG8cnsnqmd

And Subscribe to @ThinkLink_YT on youtube!!
